meta.title: Android Emulator
meta.description: Lets the agent boot an Android emulator, install an APK, tap/swipe/type like a user, and see the screen (screenshots, UI tree) plus logcat — closing the loop from code change to install, interaction and assertion. ARM64 APKs are supported through the x86_64 image's built-in libndk_translation layer: installs are reported as native or translated, with a performance warning when translation is involved. Zero-dependency host plugin, one device at a time.
